title: Soft and Comfortable
text: Soft and Comfortable. Nice, soft faux fur on 1 side, velvety material on the other side.  I thought they were faux fur on both sides, which would give me the ability to display both sides.

features: Material :The front of fuzzy pillow case are made of 45mm high pile microfiber long shaggy fleece and the back are ultra soft crystal velvet fiber. Anti-fading,anti-wrinkle,anti-pilling and create a luxury feeling.

Size Information：Set of 2 faux fur pillow shams with same color, no insert.18" X 18"/20" X 26"/20" X 36".Hidden zipper closure in the middle of the back side, graceful and comfort, easy to keep the fuzzy pillows stay in place and remove to wash.

Perfect Decoration：Boasting a plush and comfy construction, this unique pillow of sumptuous fabric is an easy way to bring a modern edge to your bedroom or living room decor. Give your collection a touch of classic sophistication. Suitable for couch, sofa, bed, car, seat, window seat, loveseat, living room, bedroom, floor, bench, office, cafe ect.Perfect gift for Home Decor,Housewarming ,Valentine's Day ,Mother's Day ,Anniversary ,Christmas and so on.

Easy Care & Clean:Turning it inside-out, machine wash cold on gentle cycle. Tumble dry low or dry flat. Avoid hang dry which will cause deformation. Do not bleach. Do not Iron. Please refer to the care label. We suggest washing before first use as it sheds a bit for produce cutting.

100% Satisfaction Service: LIFEREVO appreciate you love our products like our other 5-star reviewers that we offer a 30-day return and replacement service. If you have any questions, please contact us to get a satisfied solution.
